drums.tags: Funk rock instrumental featuring a prominent, syncopated electric bass line with a bright, percussive tone. The track is set in 4/4 time at 115 BPM in the key of E minor. A clean electric guitar provides rhythmic scratching and muted strums, while a second electric guitar enters with a wah-wah filter effect, playing rhythmic 16th-note patterns. The drum kit maintains a steady groove with a crisp snare and active hi-hat embellishments. The arrangement follows a repetitive structure built around a central four-bar bass riff that utilizes hammer-ons and pull-offs. A subtle synthesizer pad provides harmonic depth in the background during the bridge section.
drums.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[percussive slap bass riff enters]
[clean electric guitar muted scratching]

[Section A]
[drum kit enters with steady backbeat]
[wah-wah electric guitar rhythmic 16th notes]
[bass continues syncopated E minor riff]

[Section B]
[sustained synthesizer pads in background]
[hi-hat opens for accents]
[bass riff varies with higher register fills]

[Outro]
[wah-wah guitar fades out]
[bass and drums continue until abrupt stop]
